title: Daily restricted finance report from verified connected data

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Recovered native policy specifies the report; actual connected Finances bindings, data access, backend timezone and destination readback remain unverified.
Verify current reporting date, month-to-date boundary, stored budget version and source coverage before calculating spending versus budget.
Classify transfers and credit-card payments separately from true spending; reconcile their ledger representation so the same spending is not counted twice.
Use source-backed category totals, received income, cash/checking/savings, important credit/debt balances, upcoming concerns and AI/subscription spending or warnings.
Use only verified figures and as-of dates; unresolved classification or unavailable data is an explicit gap, never zero or guessed spending.
Keep the report brief and action-oriented in its restricted existing destination; do not copy financial history, identifiers or profiles into core or another provider.

success_checks: Report covers month-to-date spending versus stored budget, key categories, received income, current cash/checking/savings, important credit/debt concerns and AI/subscription spending or warnings.
Spending reconciliation excludes transfers and card payments already represented by underlying purchases; uncertain classifications remain visible.
Every figure has current source/as-of evidence; missing coverage is explicit and no financial action, advice or delivery is inferred from recovered policy.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
